# Text carrying the three characters beancount reads as punctuation.
#
# A double quote ends a beancount string, a semicolon starts a comment, and a
# backslash escapes whatever follows it. All three turn up in ordinary text — a
# supplier named in quotes, a note with a clause in it, a Windows path in a
# document link. Written into the export raw, the file this tool produced could
# not be read by this tool: the description ran to the first inner quote and
# the rest of the line was not a header, so the parse refused, and a refused
# parse takes the whole ledger rather than one entry.
#
# The three of them together is where escaping goes wrong rather than missing:
#
#   - a quote *and* a semicolon in one description — the comment stripper
#     counts quotes and the string reader honours `\"`, and if they disagree
#     the line is cut inside its own string;
#   - a backslash before an `n` — `C:\name` escapes to `C:\\name`, and reading
#     the escapes one replacement at a time turned it into `C:\` + a newline +
#     `ame`;
#   - a link ending in a backslash, which is what a Windows directory looks
#     like.
#
# Every field here is free text a person typed, and every one is read back
# through the same rule.
#
# What this fixture produces: four transactions and an account whose text has
# to come back exactly as written.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_beancount_export_reads_back_as_itself.py.
2024-01-01 commodity XCD
	mnemonic: "XCD"
	fullname: "East Caribbean Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

2024-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"
2024-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	code: "A\"B"
	description: "Called \"Old\" until 2023; renamed since"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"
2024-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"
2024-01-01 open Expenses:Sundry
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "XCD"

2024-02-01 * "Paid \"Acme\" Ltd"
	Assets:Bank -25.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 25.00 XCD

2024-02-02 * "Lunch; and coffee"
	Assets:Bank -15.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 15.00 XCD

2024-02-03 * "Paid \"Acme; Ltd\""
	Assets:Bank -35.00 XCD
	Expenses:Sundry 35.00 XCD

2024-02-04 * "Filed under C:\\name"
	doc_link: "file:///C:\\receipts\\"
	Assets:Bank -45.00 XCD
		memo: "Kept in C:\\name; see the folder"
	Expenses:Sundry 45.00 XCD
